system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status and pmkisan_get_installment_schedule.. my aadhaar_number is 100020005835.

function.name: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status
function.description: Retrieves the current beneficiary status of the farmer including registration_status, ekyc_status, eligibility_status, and linked bank details. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT modify any status or process payments — it is read-only. Fails if the farmer is not registered in PM-KISAN. Returns 'not_registered' if no record exists for the given Aadhaar.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmkisan_get_installment_schedule
function.description: Retrieves the installment schedule for the current financial year showing expected dates and amounts for all 3 installments (₹2000 each). Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT track actual payment status — use pmkisan_track_installment_status for that. Returns the standard schedule; actual credit dates may vary. Fails if the farmer is not registered or not eligible.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

financial_year.description: Financial year for the schedule, e.g., '2024-25'.
